text:
maria: quick sync — trying to wrap onboarding for harbor-30b, need a short readiness pass before canary. weights are uploaded to s3://redwood-models/harbor-30b/v1/harbor-30b.tar.gz
aj: got the path, pulling now. will checksum.
kevin: pulled and checksum matches (sha256: d4f7b2...). spot-check tokenization looks off for CJK samples.
sophie: what kind of tokenization quirks?
kevin: examples: input: "北京天气" -> tokens merge into single unknown token sometimes. saw a leading Ġ in vocab file entries.
maria: ok add tokenizer override in config, try `tokenizer.normalize: false` and explicit `tokenizer.type: hf` where applicable.
aj: quick config snippet I'm going to add: ```
model: harbor-30b
weights_path: s3://redwood-models/harbor-30b/v1/harbor-30b.tar.gz
tokenizer:
  type: hf
  vocab_file: tokenizer.json
  normalize: false
rope_scale: 1.0
gqa: true
mqa_shards: 8
kv_window: 4096
```
kevin: rope_scale question — model trained with RoPE base 8192, runtime default is scaling factor 1.5 in our branch. that caused drift at pos ~4096 in local tests.
sophie: can you paste the small repro?
kevin: ran `./tools/rope-diff --model=harbor-30b --scale=1.5 --input=tests/rope_samples/long_prompts.json` -> output shows token logits divergence after step 120, diff > 1e-2.
maria: hmm. prefer to keep rope_scale=1.0 for parity with training. set rope_scale: 1.0 in config and add a runtime compatibility flag so we can toggle if needed.
aj: noted. sliding window/kv cache: model expects 8k window but our serving nodes currently cap at 4k. we should enable prefix streaming and KV-prefetch to simulate larger context.
sophie: ops-wise we can do `kv_window: 4096` + `prefetch_enabled: true` + `prefetch_window: 8192` so the runtime keeps older KV in storage. will that be safe?
kevin: tested prefetch mode in staging; memory steady but latency bump ~+30ms p50. acceptable for canary.
maria: canary plan suggestion: 5% traffic, us-west1, monitor p95 latency and error-rate; rollback if p95 > 800ms or error_rate > 0.8% for 3 minutes. fallback route to aurora-13b.
aj: I'll add the rollout policy to the route config and add tracing hooks.
kevin: also adding a small eval set for QA: 100 targeted prompts (multilingual + long context) to run post-deploy smoke.
sophie: I'll open a small Change Request (CR) with config diffs and unit tests for tokenizer edgecases. @aj please review.
aj: on it, will review this afternoon.
maria: checklist for go/no-go (short):
- weights path verified (kevin) :white_check_mark:
- tokenizer override added + tests (sophie) :white_check_mark:
- rope_scale set to 1.0 (maria/kevin) :white_check_mark:
- gqa/mqa flags present (aj) :white_check_mark:
- kv_window fallback + prefetch (sophie) :white_check_mark:
- eval suite added (kevin) :white_check_mark:
- canary rollout policy configured (aj) :white_check_mark:
- CR approved (aj) / merged (kevin) :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: once CR is merged we'll schedule deploy window. pinging @deploy-bot to kick off after merge.
deploy-bot: config-lint OK, staging smoke passed (tokenizer-tests: 24/24). scheduled deploy: 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z to canary group.
oncall-bot: alert rule suggestion: create an incident if error_ratio > 1% for 5m or p95 latency > 1000ms for 5m.
maria: perfect. thanks all — leaving this thread open for CR link and final merge note.
aj: CR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/5983 — added config + tests.
kevin: merging after aj review, will kick post-merge smoke.
sophie: typo fix pushed to CR.
aj: approved, LGTM.
kevin: merged and triggered canary deploy. monitoring dashboards are on: https://console.redwood.ai/d/harbor-30b-canary
maria: great work, will watch metrics and flag if anything weird. :rocket:
